evaluation.primary_population_note: W1+W4 pilot, 9,064 rows; queue primary 0.8299435 is full-six and is not used as a pilot control metric

recipe.fit_population: all official Train rows with cycle_code <= the temporal cutoff

queue_card.change: Retain original word TF-IDF; append char_wb(3,5) min_df3/max_features30000/sublinear, lowercase Unicode strip. Original sparse classifier. Anonymous hash fragments have no semantic interpretation.
queue_card.name: Word + character sparse boosting
preflight_checks: Memory estimate and train-only vocab; no dense conversion
queue_card.rationale: Learner nonlinear berbeda dari character LR/Ridge yang gagal. Token hash-like memberi dasar subword yang lemah, sehingga prioritas rendah.

single_recipe_change.added_block: char_wb TF-IDF ngrams 3-5, min_df=3, max_features=30000, sublinear_tf=True

recipe.structured_preprocessing: C04 fit-only numeric scaling and sparse OHE; unchanged

recipe.fit_population: all official Classification Train rows with 47 <= cycle_code <= cutoff; no row weights or downsampling

prediction_policy.baseline: fixed v3_cls_sparse25: 0.75 frozen C2_B + 0.25 original sparse expert on present; frozen CatBoost on missing
prediction_policy.present_stream: 0.75 * frozen C2_B probability + 0.25 * new C17 longer-regularized sparse expert probability

queue_recipe.change: Original word/structured matrix, leaves15/min_child100/lambda5,600trees/lr0.05. Second and last sparse_capacity configuration. No outer early stopping.
queue_recipe.name: Longer regularized sparse boosting

recipe.scoring_population: STANDARD cutoff-55/67 views, row-aligned by saved Train row positions and record_id
recipe.source_model: SparseTextBoostClassifier design with C17 fixed sparse-capacity changes
recipe.structured_recipe: RegressionTextModel._structured_fit/_structured_transform; fit only on current cutoff's past rows
recipe.subgroup_support_rule: guard n>=200 and each class count>=30; smaller or single-class groups descriptive only

text_recipe.missing_stream: empty document plus explicit binary missing column

recipe.model: LightGBM regression_l1; sparse structured/OHE + char_wb TF-IDF + missing indicator
recipe.rank50: within each complete score cycle; average ties; percentile=100*rank/n; rank50=0.5*raw+0.5*percentile; clip[0,100]
recipe.semantic_interpretation: Character n-grams are anonymous text fragments; no semantic interpretation is made.
recipe.structured_preprocessing: RegressionTextModel fit-only numeric imputation/scaling and OneHotEncoder; original R02 structured design

recipe.median_assumption: Linear interpolation between decile thresholds approximates a continuous conditional median. S(0)=1 is valid only when each fit fold has no exact target zero; R11 fails closed otherwise. Official Train audit found minimum target 0.0428 and zero exact zeros; freeze preflight rechecks both folds. S(100)=0 follows strict y>100 being false.
recipe.model: Nine cumulative binary LightGBM heads for threat_rank > 10,...,90; row-wise nonincreasing PAVA; linearly interpolated median crossing

accepted_control.route: .5625 rank50 LightGBM SVD32 + .1875 rank75 Hybrid Ridge + .25 rank50 sparse LightGBM

recipe.metric: MAE; positive gain = baseline MAE - candidate MAE
recipe.prediction_policy: .75 exact current three-component champion + .25 rank50(new raw target-scale prediction), clip[0,100]; rank50 uses 50% raw and 50% average-rank percentile computed separately within each complete 12-cycle scoring cycle

C11.prediction: .75 C2_B + .25 C11 for present; frozen CB_MISSING for missing; threshold 0.50

C17.prediction: .75 C2_B + .25 C17 for present; frozen CB_MISSING for missing; threshold 0.50

R06.prediction: original all-row rank50 R06; .75 three-component champion + .25 mapped candidate; clip [0,100]

R11.prediction: nine strict cumulative heads >10..90; PAVA; interpolated median; rank50 once per cycle; .75 champion + .25; clip [0,100]

R21.prediction: original reg:absoluteerror; rank50 raw once within complete cycle; .75 champion + .25 mapped candidate; clip [0,100]
